searchText: Hi <@892053833121923094> , just created this PR (https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/592) to increase the invalid ancestor timeout tests a little bit so Besu can pass them is there a watching by ethstaker this time for Sepolia merge? That's a question for the ethstaker Discord. And yes there will be. We will likely start half an hour before whatever time bordel.wtf predicts. thanks <@219015859182632960> Thanks Fabio, I approved but we need <@194432762315407360> to help us merge <@892053833121923094> just opened an issue for a problem that prevents test execution at least on Besu https://github.com/ethereum/hive/issues/593 I'm taking a look, thanks! How do you propose we balance both the desire for broad compatibility across clients and the ability to evolve the apis? I lean towards clients simply introducing new methods if they want different functionality, preferably with a non-`eth` prefix IMO optional values within standardized methods makes it too easy for tooling to simply use those values without considering that not all clients support it issue is being tracked here: https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/issues/3921
